title: Systems Engineer (Diagnostic Calibration Engineer)
description:
**Requisition Summary**
**PACCAR India** 
 is looking for a skilled
 **Systems Engineer (Diagnostic Calibration Engineer)** 
 to join its dynamic team in Pune. The role involves supporting diagnostic calibration, validation, and fault management activities for engine and aftertreatment systems, enabling robust diagnostic performance and compliance across vehicle development programs
   

  

 At PACCAR, you’ll be part of a purpose\-driven organization known for engineering excellence, innovation, and a strong commitment to employee growth and well\-being. We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, your contributions make a real difference, and your career can thrive as you help build world\-class products that power the future of transportation.
   

  

**Job Function / Responsibilities**
* Support fault management and diagnostic calibration activities for engine and aftertreatment systems.
* Perform diagnostic validation across HIL, engine, and vehicle test environments.
* Execute OBD calibration activities and validate electrical signals and diagnostic functionality.
* Create and maintain test cases to support diagnostic verification and validation activities.
* Perform fault simulation and diagnostic evaluations using approved technical documentation.
* Analyse diagnostic and field test data to identify issues and support corrective actions.
* Prepare calibration reports, validation summaries, and technical recommendations.
* Support troubleshooting activities during product development and validation phases.
* Perform IUMPR analysis to assess OBD monitor performance and compliance
* Participate in at least one scheduled weekend support activity per month to support project, testing, or release requirements.


**Qualification**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics / Mechanical / Automobile / Electronics Engineering


**Required Skills**
**Technical / Professional Experience Requirements:** 
 3 to 6 Years
   

  

**Domain Knowledge:** 
 Automotive – Diagnostics and Calibration
   

  

**Primary Skills:** 
 Engine diagnostics, fault management, OBD systems, diagnostic calibration, diagnostic validation, electrical schematics, logic diagrams, fault simulation.
   

  

**Secondary Skills:** 
 Quality Center (ALM\-QC), MATLAB/Python Scripting
   

  

**Competencies And Behaviors**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to interpret complex diagnostic data and test results.
* Structured approach to troubleshooting and issue investigation.
* Effective technical communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Attention to detail and commitment to engineering quality.

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
**Job Description – Linux L3 System Administrator** 




**Job Summary** 




 The Linux L3 System Administrator is responsible for advanced architecture, administration, troubleshooting, and optimization of large\-scale Linux environments. This role provides technical leadership, handles complex incidents and escalations, drives automation and standardization, and ensures platform stability, security, and performance across on‑premise and cloud infrastructures.
 



  
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Provide L3\-level support for Linux OS (RHEL, Oracle Linux, CentOS, Rocky Linux)
* Act as final technical escalation point for complex OS, performance, and availability issues
* Lead major incident troubleshooting, perform deep\-dive analysis, and deliver Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Design, build, and maintain highly available and scalable Linux platforms
* Own OS builds, upgrades, kernel updates, and lifecycle management
* Architect and support LVM, multipathing (DM‑Multipath, PowerPath), and enterprise storage integrations
* Implement and maintain automation using Ansible, shell scripting, Python
* Provide advanced support for VMware and physical server infrastructures
* Drive security hardening, vulnerability remediation, and audit compliance
* Support cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) – OS provisioning, optimization, and troubleshooting
* Collaborate with application, database, network, and security teams on solution design
* Mentor L1/L2 engineers and review SOPs, standards, and best practices
* Participate in 24x7 on\-call rotations and planned maintenance activities



  
 



 Required Skills \& Experience
 


* 8–10\+ years of enterprise Linux system administration experience
* Deep expertise in RHEL/Oracle Linux
* Strong experience with:
+ LVM, multipathing, SAN/NAS storage
+ System performance tuning and analysis
+ Advanced troubleshooting in production

* Hands\-on experience with Ansible automation
* Strong shell scripting skills (Bash); Python desirable
* Experience with ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM tools
* Strong understanding of networking concepts (bonding, VLANs, routing basics)
* Experience supporting 24x7 mission‑critical environments



  
 



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* RHCE / RHCA or equivalent certifications
* Experience with container platforms (Docker/Kubernetes) – OS perspective
* Exposure to cloud\-native Linux deployments
* Experience in ITIL\-aligned operations



  
 



 Professional Attributes
 


* Strong ownership mindset and decision‑making capabilities
* Ability to handle high‑pressure, business‑critical incidents
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Passion for automation, standardization, and continuous improvement



  
 



  
 



*"We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to caste, colour, creed, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, HIV status, or any other status protected by law. Candidates with disabilities who require accommodations during the recruitment process are encouraged to contact our Talent Acquisition team to place a request."*

Senior Rust Systems Engineer – Embedded Proxy & Appliance
description:
Senior Rust Systems Engineer – Embedded Proxy \& Appliance
 
 Remote, India \| Direct Hire \| 6\+ Years Total (3\+ Years Production Rust)
 



**About Securly** 




 Securly is a K\-12 EdTech company built around one mission: keeping students safe and well, both online and off. Our platform gives schools the infrastructure to filter and monitor web traffic, flag signs of self\-harm or bullying, and support student wellness — all while giving IT teams tools that hold up on real school networks, not just in a demo. That mission runs straight through this role: the edge proxy appliance is core infrastructure sitting inside thousands of school networks, and it has to work every single school day, at scale, without fail.
 



 We're a team of roughly 330 people across Pune, the US, and the UK, working across engineering, product, and customer\-facing teams to build and support that platform. Engineering in Pune plays a central role in building the systems that make Securly's safety mission possible — this isn't a satellite team, it's where core infrastructure like this gets built.
 



**The Role** 




 If you've spent your career close to the hardware — device drivers, kernel modules, cross\-compilation, bring\-up on constrained systems — and you're deep in production Rust, this is a chance to own the embedded proxy software running on a fleet of appliances deployed across thousands of school networks, from the OS layer up through the AWS control plane managing it all.
 



**Must\-Haves:** 



* Embedded Linux fundamentals — device drivers, kernel modules, cross\-compilation, or hardware bring\-up
* 3\+ years hands\-on production Rust in a systems or embedded context (not app/web Rust)
* 6\+ years total engineering experience
* Systems/network programming — TCP stream handling, socket programming, transparent proxying
* Docker/containerization for constrained/appliance deployment
* Performance testing and profiling — load testing, memory/CPU profiling, flame graph analysis
* Working knowledge of AWS and IaC concepts



**Strongly Preferred:** 
 Named fleet/IoT/embedded device product on your resume, C/C\+\+ or Go alongside Rust, eBPF/netfilter/HAProxy/Envoy exposure
 



**Nice to Have:** 
 RADIUS, observability (CloudWatch/Splunk/SLOs)
 



 Securly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristic.
